history_summary: Record the native Bacillus rugosus species-reference correspondence in the two-stock wheat TB community.
history_details: The PM16 descriptor receives the native Bacillus rugosus species-ID correspondence with five reference genomes and fraction1.0. Preserve PM16 and fungal T19 as the two TB members, the separate Fusarium challenge, 16S/ITS identification and every source stock field. Do not import the separate six-member SMC's deposit metadata or infer an experimental stock assembly, viable persistence or measured abundance from the reference population. Experimental clocks, panel references, simulated network results and metabolite hypotheses remain unchanged; issue1951 remains separate. Only one selected GTDB block/status and two native inline events changed. The pinned table has no verified upstream release label. All old events and historical lookup-unavailability notes remain, and this bounded technical correction does not complete scientific review or corpus QC.
